Tool use: **apply_patch**

<details>
        <summary>Apply patch for /Users/bietiekay/code/miataru-ios-app/miataru/miataru/views/Common/TabBarTheme.swift</summary>
      

```diff
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: miataru/miataru/views/Common/TabBarTheme.swift
+/*
+ * Copyright (c) 2013-2025, Daniel Kirstenpfad, www.miataru.com
+ *
+ * TabBarTheme.swift
+ * miataru
+ *
+ * Created by Daniel Kirstenpfad on 2025-09-12.
+ */
+
+import SwiftUI
+import UIKit
+
+/// Centralized configuration for the app's tab bar appearance and colors
+enum TabBarTheme {
+    /// Apply a unified appearance for all tab bars in the app
+    static func apply() {
+        #if os(iOS)
+        let selectedColor = UIColor(named: "AccentColor") ?? UIColor.systemOrange
+        let unselectedColor = UIColor.secondaryLabel
+
+        let appearance = UITabBarAppearance()
+        if #available(iOS 26.0, *) {
+            // Match SwiftUI modifier: transparent background on iOS 26+
+            appearance.configureWithTransparentBackground()
+        } else {
+            // Match SwiftUI modifier: ultraThin material background before iOS 26
+            appearance.configureWithDefaultBackground()
+            appearance.backgroundEffect = UIBlurEffect(style: .systemUltraThinMaterial)
+            appearance.backgroundColor = .clear
+        }
+
+        // Configure item colors for all layouts
+        [appearance.stackedLayoutAppearance,
+         appearance.inlineLayoutAppearance,
+         appearance.compactInlineLayoutAppearance].forEach { layout in
+            layout.normal.iconColor = unselectedColor
+            layout.normal.titleTextAttributes = [.foregroundColor: unselectedColor]
+            layout.selected.iconColor = selectedColor
+            layout.selected.titleTextAttributes = [.foregroundColor: selectedColor]
+        }
+
+        // Apply to UITabBar globally
+        let tabBar = UITabBar.appearance()
+        tabBar.tintColor = selectedColor
+        tabBar.unselectedItemTintColor = unselectedColor
+        tabBar.standardAppearance = appearance
+        if #available(iOS 15.0, *) {
+            tabBar.scrollEdgeAppearance = appearance
+        }
+        #endif
+    }
+}
+
*** End Patch
```

- I searched for all `TabView`/`tabItem` and appearance usages, then implemented a centralized tab bar theme and applied it app-wide.

Key changes:
- Centralized theme: `TabBarTheme.apply()` sets `UITabBarAppearance`, selected/unselected item colors, and aligns backgrounds across iOS versions.
```12:61:miataru/miataru/views/Common/TabBarTheme.swift
enum TabBarTheme {
    static func apply() {
        let selectedColor = UIColor(named: "AccentColor") ?? UIColor.systemOrange
        let unselectedColor = UIColor.secondaryLabel
        let appearance = UITabBarAppearance()
        if #available(iOS 26.0, *) { appearance.configureWithTransparentBackground() }
        else { appearance.configureWithDefaultBackground(); appearance.backgroundEffect = UIBlurEffect(style: .systemUltraThinMaterial); appearance.backgroundColor = .clear }
        [appearance.stackedLayoutAppearance, appearance.inlineLayoutAppearance, appearance.compactInlineLayoutAppearance].forEach { layout in
            layout.normal.iconColor = unselectedColor
            layout.normal.titleTextAttributes = [.foregroundColor: unselectedColor]
            layout.selected.iconColor = selectedColor
            layout.selected.titleTextAttributes = [.foregroundColor: selectedColor]
        }
        let tabBar = UITabBar.appearance()
        tabBar.tintColor = selectedColor
        tabBar.unselectedItemTintColor = unselectedColor
        tabBar.standardAppearance = appearance
        if #available(iOS 15.0, *) { tabBar.scrollEdgeAppearance = appearance }
    }
}
```
